package player

import (
	player "example.com/tcp-perf/game/entities/player"
	"example.com/tcp-perf/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/playeraccess"
)

func (c *Controller) HandleEnterGame(ctx *playeraccess.Context, _ *pb.EnterGameRequest) (*pb.EnterGameResponse, error) {
	lifecycle, err := player.LifecycleFromRegistry(c.Registry())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, _, err = lifecycle.GetOrCreate(ctx.Context(), ctx.PlayerID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &pb.EnterGameResponse{}, nil
}
